request.subject: TERRAIN:MINED_MOUNTAIN

layers.text: Dig a mine into the foot of the mountain: add a square mine entrance framed with pale birch timber beams around a dark tunnel in the front rock face, and a small mine cart heaped with grey ore beside it. Keep the peaks, snow, grey rock, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing at all under the mountain.
